other_failure_modes.name: Target Leakage in Target Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target encoding means on the training fold and maps them directly back to the same training fold. Because a sample's own target is included in its category's mean, this causes severe target leakage and overfitting. An out-of-fold or leave-one-out strategy within the training fold is required to prevent this.

other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage from Test Set in Feature Engineering
other_failure_modes.description: The agent concatenates the training and test datasets before calculating frequency encodings for categorical variables. This leaks the statistical distribution of the test set into the training features, which is an invalid practice for real-world generalization.

summary: The solution employs a solid overall framework typical of competitive data science, including 5-fold stratified CV, advanced feature engineering, and rank-based OOF blending. However, it contains a critical target leakage bug where target encoding is applied naively to the training fold without an inner out-of-fold scheme. Additionally, frequency encodings are computed on the combined train and test sets, which technically constitutes data leakage.
